name: Legislation type
description: Kinds of legislative instrument. Deliberately broad, because the same word means different things in different legal systems; publishers should pick the nearest term and carry the local name in alternateName.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Code
hasDefinedTerm.description: A consolidated body of law, such as a municipal code.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Ordinance
hasDefinedTerm.description: A local law of general and permanent effect.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Resolution
hasDefinedTerm.description: An expression of position or an administrative decision, usually without permanent legal force.

hasDefinedTerm.name: By-law
hasDefinedTerm.description: A local law; the usual term in Commonwealth jurisdictions.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Act
hasDefinedTerm.description: Primary legislation of a national or regional legislature.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Regulation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Secondary or delegated legislation made under an enabling power.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Decree
hasDefinedTerm.description: An instrument issued by an executive authority.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Directive
hasDefinedTerm.description: An instrument binding as to result, leaving means to the implementing authority.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Motion
hasDefinedTerm.description: A proposal put to a deliberative body for decision.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Charter
hasDefinedTerm.description: The instrument constituting the government itself.
